article.title: Iran's Kharg and Larak islands: Why they matter
Iran targets US military in Jordan after American attack on Larak Island in latest flare-up
article.summary: Iran said on Monday it attacked US military targets in Jordan  in retaliation for the first American strikes on its territory in a month, marking a fresh flare-up in the six-month war.Tehran’s Revolutionary Guards (IRGC) said they struck two US military air bases with ballistic missiles in Washington-allied Jordan, causing “heavy damage”. Jordan’s army said it had intercepted eight missiles, without stating their origin.The strikes came after the United States said on Sunday it had attacked Iranian rocket launchers on a small island in the Strait of Hormuz.Washington said its attacks were aimed at preventing Iran from launching more sea mines into the strait, days after it announced it had completed clearing explosives from the strategic waterway.“US forces took limited, precise action against IRGC mine laying forces posing an imminent threat in the Strait of Hormuz,” the US Central Command (Centcom) wrote on X.The Guards said the US strikes resulted in “casualties” and that their s...

article.title: US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks
article.summary: The attack on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz - the first known US strike since late July - has killed two people and injured two others.

article.title: Watch: Trump Posts A.I. Video of Iran’s Kharg Island ‘Blown to Smithereens’
article.summary: President Donald Trump on Sunday posted a ten-second A.I.-generated video of Iran’s Kharg Island oil terminal being “blown to smithereens,” as he put it, shortly after the first U.S. airstrikes against Iran in a month. None of the actual strikes was confirmed to have targeted Kharg Island.The postWatch: Trump Posts A.I. Video of Iran’s Kharg Island ‘Blown to Smithereens’appeared first onBreitbart.
